design_philosophy: Not a corporate agency site. A living, breathing HQ for 5 people who build real AI/software under deadline pressure. Feels alive, reactive, slightly experimental — like the site itself is a piece of software, not a brochure.
avoid: Cream background + serif + terracotta accent (generic AI-site default)
Pure black + single neon-green accent (generic AI-site default)
Static, lifeless cards with no interaction feedback
Overused glass panels with no purpose (glass should reveal depth/context, not just look pretty)

color_system.notes: Deep ink-blue/near-black base, not pure black. One violet + one mint-green signal color forming the brand gradient, used sparingly as glow/accent, never as full backgrounds.

typography.display_font: Space Grotesk or Clash Display — geometric, slightly futuristic, used only for headlines
typography.body_font: Inter or General Sans — clean, highly legible at small sizes
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono — used for tags, stack labels, code-style metadata (e.g. project tech stack chips, timestamps)
typography.scale: Fluid type scale using clamp() so headlines scale smoothly between mobile and desktop
typography.treatment: Headlines use tight letter-spacing and slightly oversized weight jumps (300 body, 600 display) for contrast

glassmorphism.usage: Project cards, nav bar, modal overlays, team cards on hover
glassmorphism.depth_rule: Glass panels sit above an animated gradient mesh background so blur actually reveals moving color underneath — glass with nothing behind it to blur is pointless, always give it a living background layer

background_effects.description: 2-3 large soft-blurred gradient blobs (violet + mint) slowly drifting behind the glass layer using CSS @keyframes transform + blur, or a lightweight canvas/WebGL shader for smoother motion
background_effects.performance_note: Use CSS transform/opacity only for the cheap version; use a simple GLSL shader via a small library like OGL or vanilla WebGL only if performance budget allows on mobile
background_effects.alt_option: Subtle animated noise/grain overlay at 3-5% opacity for texture, prevents flat digital look

cursor_effects.default: Custom cursor replacing native pointer — small circle with a soft glow, color-matched to signal_primary

hover_states.on_links_buttons: Cursor expands into a larger ring and text label appears inside it (e.g. 'view', 'open', 'drag') — magnetic pull effect where cursor and element attract slightly toward each other
hover_states.on_project_cards: Cursor morphs into a small preview thumbnail or 'view project' pill that follows the mouse
hover_states.on_drag_carousel: Cursor shows a horizontal drag icon with grab/grabbing states

cursor_effects.trail_effect: Optional: faint particle trail or blur-trail following cursor movement, decaying over ~300ms, using requestAnimationFrame — kept subtle, disabled on touch devices
cursor_effects.implementation_note: Build with vanilla JS mousemove + CSS transform (translate3d for GPU acceleration), never top/left positioning

micro_interactions.buttons: Magnetic hover (button shifts slightly toward cursor within a radius), gradient border that animates on hover
micro_interactions.cards: 3D tilt on mouse move (perspective transform based on cursor position within card bounds) + glass shine sweep on hover
micro_interactions.text_reveal: Headlines split into words/characters and animate in with staggered fade+slide on scroll (SplitType + GSAP or a lightweight custom implementation)
micro_interactions.images: Subtle parallax scroll on project thumbnails (image moves slower than container)
micro_interactions.loading: Custom loading sequence on first visit — animated logo mark or terminal-style boot text before revealing hero

scroll_effects.library_suggestion: Lenis for smooth inertia scrolling + GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-linked animations
scroll_effects.hero: Pinned hero section with layered parallax as user scrolls into first project section
scroll_effects.project_carousel: Native drag-to-scroll with scroll-snap, inertia/momentum on release, cards scale slightly as they center in viewport
scroll_effects.reveal_pattern: Sections fade/slide up as they enter viewport via IntersectionObserver, staggered children (card grids animate in sequence, not all at once)

signature_element.concept: A live 'build status' strip in the nav or hero — styled like a CI/CD pipeline indicator (e.g. small animated dots/ticks that pulse like a terminal build log), reinforcing 'we ship real software' identity. This becomes the one bold, memorable motif tying the whole site together.
signature_element.placement: Persistent in nav or floating corner widget, subtle idle animation, could show something like rotating text of tech stack or recent commit-style status

layout_principles.grid: 12-column responsive grid, generous whitespace, asymmetric project grid (not uniform cards) for visual energy
layout_principles.corners: Consistent 16px radius on cards, 999px pill radius only on tags/badges
layout_principles.responsiveness: Mobile-first, cursor effects and heavy blur disabled below 768px width for performance, replaced with simple tap-state animations

accessibility.reduced_motion: All animations wrapped in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); reduced version keeps only opacity fades
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements, custom-styled to match brand rather than removed
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass/gradient backgrounds passes WCAG AA — add a subtle dark scrim behind text if needed

tech_stack_recommendation.core: Plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS (no framework, keep it fast and simple to split across team)
optional_advanced: OGL or three.js — only if adding a WebGL shader background
tech_stack_recommendation.avoid: Heavy frameworks (React/Vue) unless team already committed — adds build complexity for a 5-person static site

assets_needed_later.images: Team headshots, project screenshots/gifs, hackathon logos (SVG preferred, transparent bg)
assets_needed_later.fonts: Self-hosted woff2 files for chosen display + body fonts (avoid pure Google Fonts CDN dependency for speed)
assets_needed_later.icons: Consistent icon set (Phosphor or Tabler icons) for stack tags, socials, nav
assets_needed_later.video: Optional short project demo clips (mp4, under 5MB each, muted autoplay loop) for hero/project cards
